title.narrative: Young men and women have increased entrepreneurship and technical skills for self-employment and productive economic activities

description.narrative:
Seychelles is committed to creating a brighter future for its youth, promoting entrepreneurship, and ensuring a fair transition to a formal economy. To achieve this, the country has developed a comprehensive plan with four key objectives:
Objective 1: Skills Programs for Vulnerable Youth
By December 2023, the Ministry of Employment will develop innovative skills programs for youth in vulnerable situations. These programs will:
Address the specific needs of vulnerable youth Equip participants with skills and knowledge for decent work opportunities Foster entrepreneurial mindsets and transferable skills Be flexible and accessible to diverse needs and circumstances Objective 2: Supporting Entrepreneurship
The Ministry of Employment will work with the Seychelles Chamber of Commerce and Industry to implement the SIYB Action Plan by December 2023. This initiative aims to:
Foster entrepreneurship development and job creation Enhance the skills and knowledge of entrepreneurs Promote micro and small enterprises Objective 3: Transition to Formal Economy
By December 2024, the Ministry of Employment will develop a comprehensive strategy on the transition to formal economy. This strategy will:
Identify key sectors for formalization Develop a roadmap and action plan for formalization Address challenges and barriers to formalization Promote the benefits of formality for employers and employees Objective 4: Tripartite Committee on Just Transition
A tripartite committee will be established to oversee the implementation of a just transition to a formal economy. The committee will:
Provide guidance and recommendations on the transition strategy Monitor progress and ensure inclusivity Foster dialogue and collaboration among stakeholders By achieving these objectives, Seychelles can create a more inclusive and prosperous future for its youth, empower entrepreneurs, and ensure a smooth and just transition to a formal economy for all.
